verdict.rationale: Steel documents integrations across many LLM/agent ecosystems — OpenAI Computer Use, Claude Computer Use, Gemini Computer Use, Browser-Use, CrewAI, Pydantic AI (explicitly 'provider-agnostic'), OpenAI Agents SDK, AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK — showing it is not locked to a single vendor's models and can be paired with whichever LLM the developer chooses. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party 'model-agnostic' positioning statement and independent/community corroboration of using Steel with a non-default LLM provider.
